utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the sixteenth. Can you all hear me? Right, let's get going.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Morning. Anyone actually manage their weekend plans with that weather? We planned a walk and got as far as the café.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's a successful walk in my book. Mine involved a leaking shed and some fairly strong language.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Did anyone watch the football last night, though? Honestly, those last ten minutes.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Don't. I've come to work to get away from that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ha, right. Before we get onto what's outstanding, anything finished off?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, tested the boiler safety valve yesterday and it's all fine now. That's done, nothing further from that test.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, that's closed then.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit last night. That's completed, not something still waiting for today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lovely. That one had been hanging about a bit.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Also, just because it was still showing in the old notes, I signed off the inspection on the fire alarm panel on Tuesday. Already done.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I've seen the sign-off. No outstanding action on that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Less cheerful one: still waiting on parts for the water booster. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, still waiting. No change on that, unfortunately.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And we can't get to the palletiser until production gives us a window. That's still a blocker, not permission to dive in while it's running.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Absolutely. No one's going into it without the proper stop and isolation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Callum, can you clear the jam and check the sensors on the palletizer by Wednesday? That's the job we need agreed, with that access constraint understood.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the palletizer by Wednesday, provided we get that production window. I can own it; I can't magic the access.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. By Wednesday remains the requirement, and the access blocker stays visible against it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Um, while we're on noises and stoppages, I heard a slight rattle from the GT2. Nothing to action yet, just an observation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, not turning that rattle into another job.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Same sort of thing from me: heard a slight rattle from the feedwater pump. Nothing to action yet on that either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Separate from the noise, Dave, can you inspect the Boiler Feedwater Pump for leaks tomorrow? No rush.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll inspect the Boiler Feedwater Pump for leaks tomorrow. No rush, understood.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Just checking, that's a leak inspection, not a strip-down because of the rattle?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Correct. Leaks only for that job. The slight rattle's just an observation at this point.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And I'll investigate the pressure drop on the GT2 water valve tomorrow. That's a separate issue from the noise Aisha mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, David Whitfield. Got you down for investigating the pressure drop on the GT2 water valve tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, separate things. My rattle comment wasn't a request to start chasing that as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you book a contractor to look at the GT2? Monday for the booking, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, I'll book a contractor to look at the GT2 on Monday, today. Low priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's the booking on Monday, to be clear. We're not promising they'll actually be here today.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Exactly, booking only. No attendance date being agreed here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you order spare parts for the trucks by 11am? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll order spare parts for the trucks by 11am. Not an emergency, but I won't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Welcome to the glamorous world of ordering things.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Living the dream. Almost as exciting as that football.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, my bit: I'll update the risk assessment for work on the IM2 after lunch. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: So first after lunch, rather than it getting buried under everything else?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. After lunch, that comes first for me because it's holding production up.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers, Sarah. Clear on that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team for next Tuesday. Not an emergency but don't let it slip—that's how I'm treating it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Callum Reid. Toolbox talk for next Tuesday, then.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, I'll organise it. It's not a drop-everything one, but next Tuesday won't get forgotten.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good. Better than everyone discovering there's a talk as they're halfway through a brew.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We've also got the filter to swap on the Compressed Air Dryer, tomorrow at 9:30. That's holding production up so it needs doing first. Who can take that?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Um, I can't commit to that slot. Don't put my name against it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I can't take it either. Sorry, talking over you there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. The filter swap on the Compressed Air Dryer is still needed tomorrow at 9:30, but there's nobody owning it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's a fairly uncomfortable gap if it's holding production.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: It is. The priority hasn't changed—it needs doing first—but I haven't got an acceptance, so it stays unassigned.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: There's another gap: someone needs to do a site visit at Harbour Road Warehouse with the contractor today at 2pm. Fairly important, that one. I'm raising it, not volunteering.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone able to take the Harbour Road Warehouse visit with the contractor, today at 2pm?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Not me, I'm afraid. And just to avoid crossed wires, accepting the GT2 booking wasn't me accepting this visit.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I can't take the visit either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Nobody assigned to the Harbour Road Warehouse visit. Today at 2pm is still the requirement; we're not pretending it's covered.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, fairly important still, even with that blank against it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Nothing else from quality. The two things I mentioned were both finished, not additions to today's list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. And the observations haven't quietly become extra jobs either.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Have we got an echo, or is someone agreeing with everything I say?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Definitely an echo. Don't get used to that level of support.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before Teams starts repeating the whole meeting, anything else already on the list that we've misunderstood?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: No, clear here.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Clear. Water booster's still blocked on parts, that's all—not another job I'm starting today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Thanks, everyone. We'll leave it there.
